47/G.goal: Assess the Majuli VR tour implementation by understanding its empirical evaluation design and interpreting its presence and cybersickness outcomes.
47/G.achieves: It gives the learner a concrete model for evaluating whether an XR implementation supports immersive experience and comfort, supporting the course aim to understand and implement XR systems with confidence.

47/O1.goal: Describe how a controlled empirical evaluation of the Majuli VR tour implementation is set up and conducted.
47/O1.achieves: It lets the learner understand what evidence and procedures are needed to judge whether an XR implementation supports immersive experience and user comfort.

47/O2.goal: Interpret what the Majuli VR tour evaluation results show about the implemented system's presence and cybersickness.
47/O2.achieves: It gives the learner the basis to connect XR system implementation choices to measurable user-experience outcomes and to recognize comfort-related issues.
